lines: Bhawna Nitin Gupta is a Promoter holding 3,960,000 shares before the offer and is not selling in it.
The offer price is unknown, so the value of the retained shares cannot be stated yet.
Shares above the 20% promoter level unlock 6 months from Allotment; the Minimum Promoters' Contribution unlocks at 18 months, so more money comes later.
Allotment date is not confirmed in the documents, so the timing cannot be dated yet.
